column3: The general objects for which the body corporate is

column2: constituted are hereby declared to be–

column3: to  promote  and  disseminate  knowledge  of
psychology and its application in Sri Lanka;
to encourage research into professional knowledge

in  psychology  with  a  view 
to  promoting
professional knowledge of psychology;
to  regulate  the  professional  activities  of  the
members  and  maintain  proper  standards  in  the
development,  standardization,  use  and  evaluation
of instruments and devices used in the practice of
psychology in Sri Lanka;
to safeguard the professional interest of members
and to render assistance to expand the knowledge
and professional expertise;
to  render  assistance  in  doing  experiments,  and
making publications on psychology and facilitate
access to relevant material;
to establish a Code of Ethical Conduct in order to
promote ethical practice and prevent malpractices
of  members  and  others  involved  in  the  field  of
psychology;
to  organize  conferences,  workshops,  lectures  and
provide networking opportunities in various areas
of  psychology;
